root_cause.explanation: A dynamic refrigerator housing tips under gravity on its floor contacts; initially vertical un-driven door hinges then tilt and convert gravity of the right door/panel into opening torque. Existing joints are retained; no evidence of internal contact forcing or lost joints.

mobility.scope: External torque is diagnostic, not robot task completion. The original un-driven door may coast after a deliberate pulse; this is separate from the 40s no-torque neutral validation.

retained_failed_probe.reason: Probe rejected a valid static cabinet-frame joint anchor before collecting; static and dynamic endpoints must be distinguished.

pear.diagnosis: Finite initial settling followed by exactly static native poses/velocities, consistent with PhysX sleep (sleep flag not queried), not persistent uncontrolled rotation; original 2s settling gate still fails. No pear physics or state was changed.
pear.video_scope: Pear is not visible in the original robot cameras or the supplementary refrigerator overview; this finding relies on native body pose and velocity evidence.

new_preregistered_protocol.status: Not yet executed; original failure retained

final_long_neutral.scope: Independent recomputation from recorded native arrays; source/runtime mapping metadata and source code additionally inspected. Current single environment only; original rejected 2s-window probe retained.
